known.via: English Wikipedia "Dealu Mare (wine region)" (redirects to "Dealu Mare wine region")

climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A Muntenia wine region where the area around Valea Călugărească in Prahova County is best known for reds, and Pietroasele in Buzău County for whites. It is typically seen as one of Romania's most important regions, and its PDO rules allow a very wide set of grapes.
